scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening theme music and credits roll over backstage imagery for Episode 15.

scenes.title: Leveraging the Hotel Footage
scenes.summary: When an agency manager demands that his spoiled idol stay on the travel show, Chun Yuqiao calmly threatens to leak hotel security footage to Lutiao unless the agency sends its sidelined star instead.

scenes.title: Agency Complaint and the Chairwoman's Demotion Order
scenes.summary: The humiliated agent complains to his company president, prompting external pressure that leads Xingtian's chairwoman to issue a disciplinary notice demoting Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: The Demotion Bulletin
scenes.summary: Reading Xingtian's bulletin stripping Chun Yuqiao of his executive post and cutting his salary in half, Xiaoye guesses he took the fall for Bu Xiaogu, who frantically tries to reach him.

scenes.title: Panic Before the Overseas Shoot
scenes.summary: Gathered with luggage for their overseas shoot, the production crew panics over Chun Yuqiao's sudden demotion while Lin Jie and Bu Xiaogu try to steady everyone.

scenes.title: Standing Up for Chun Yuqiao
scenes.summary: Realising Chun Yuqiao was punished for defending the crew against an abusive idol, Bu Xiaogu rallies everyone to appeal to the chairwoman on his behalf.

scenes.title: Joining the Crew Overseas
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao walks out with his suitcase, cheerfully announces he now has time to direct the overseas shoot in person, and approves Bu Xiaogu's leave request so she can finish her thesis.

scenes.title: Entertainment News on the Overseas Shoot and Charity Tour
scenes.summary: Entertainment broadcasts report on Xingtian's star-studded overseas reality shoot and Xin Huimei's sold-out nationwide charity concert tour.

scenes.title: Essential Oils and Gossip Headlines
scenes.summary: Backstage after her concert, Xin Huimei learns that Chun Yuqiao left a detailed care checklist for her insomnia and allergies, then laughs off a viral Lutiao article calling him her husband-to-be.

scenes.title: Number One in Audience Anticipation
scenes.summary: Returning from the overseas shoot, Kaiwen banters with Xingzi, brings back her shopping haul, and celebrates Fentuan data ranking their first trailer number one in viewer anticipation.

scenes.title: Dodging the Boss and Dating News
scenes.summary: Kaiwen and Xingzi discuss how miserable Chun Yuqiao looked abroad while Bu Xiaogu avoided him, until Xingzi stuns Kaiwen with news that Bu Xiaogu has started dating someone else.

scenes.title: Master's Thesis Defence at Media College
scenes.summary: At Media College, Professor Fang introduces independent panel expert Chun Yuqiao as Bu Xiaogu defends her thesis on original Chinese television, and students crowd around Chun Yuqiao afterward.
scenes.location: Media College defence hall and courtyard

scenes.title: No Longer Keeping Her Distance
scenes.summary: After her defence, Bu Xiaogu thanks Chun Yuqiao from the heart, apologises for deliberately keeping her distance, and takes a campus photo beside him.

scenes.title: Leaving Campus After the Defence
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu's boyfriend picks her up outside Media College to celebrate her thesis defence just as news breaks that Xin Huimei and Chun Yuqiao have parted ways.

scenes.title: Xin Huimei's Dignified Farewell
scenes.summary: When Chun Yuqiao offers to take leave to accompany her, Xin Huimei reveals she is flying abroad tomorrow and gently ends their relationship, wishing them both happiness.

scenes.title: Storm Warnings and Moving Into the Office for Finale Week
scenes.summary: As weather reports warn of heavy rain, Bu Xiaogu chats with her roommate about reclaiming her degree and moves into Xingtian for three days ahead of the Twelve Singers finale.

scenes.title: Every Question in the Boss's Exact Order
scenes.summary: Before Chun Yuqiao arrives for the finale check, Bu Xiaogu hands Kaiwen and Xingzi a checklist predicting every question he will ask in his exact logical sequence.

scenes.title: Seventy-Two Hours Ready for the Live Finale
scenes.summary: Before Chun Yuqiao can finish a single question, Bu Xiaogu and Xingzi report that DTS, backup directors, singers, emergency plans, and broadcast trucks are all confirmed.

scenes.title: Liberating the Workaholic Boss
scenes.summary: Kaiwen urges Chun Yuqiao to relax and go spend the morning with his visiting five-year-old daughter, leaving Bu Xiaogu startled to learn Chun Yuqiao has a child living abroad.

scenes.title: Breaking News of Overseas Attacks and Risk Debate
scenes.summary: News of bombings and shootings overseas prompts Chun Yuqiao to convene an emergency executive meeting where Stella and department heads debate the fallout for their new travel show.

scenes.title: Chun Yuqiao Refuses to Greenlight Broadcast Prematurely
scenes.summary: Despite pressure from DTS, Stella, and the chairwoman to air the travel show on schedule, Chun Yuqiao refuses to release the master tape until the Chief Editor's Office completes its assessment.

scenes.title: Confirming Every Cast and Crew Member's Safety
scenes.summary: Fighting stomach pain behind closed doors, Chun Yuqiao orders Xingzi and the team to personally verify the safety of every overseas participant while keeping Bu Xiaogu on storm watch.

scenes.title: Searching for the Unreachable Star and Orange Storm Alert
scenes.summary: Xingzi confronts an unhelpful agent when the travel show's lead star cannot be reached, while Bu Xiaogu urgently activates Xingtian's orange rainstorm contingency plan with Lin Jie.

scenes.title: Housekeeper Visit and Orange Rainstorm Contingency
scenes.summary: Kaiwen tracks down the star's housekeeper and learns he stayed at his family home abroad, just as an orange rainstorm alert hits and Bu Xiaogu orders Lin Jie to execute emergency measures tonight.
